meta.name: dbt-debugging
meta.description: Load when dbt run or dbt parse fails. Covers YML duplicate patches, ref errors, passthrough model warnings, current_date fixes, DuckDB error messages, and zero-row diagnosis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 当dbt运行失败时，Claude会自动诊断并修复YML重复补丁、ref未找到、当前日期函数问题、DuckDB错误及零行模型等常见问题。
howto.when: 当dbt run或dbt parse失败时触发。

say.note: Claude会在多个YML文件中查找并移除重复定义。
Claude会判断是否为原始表并创建临时存根或直接替换引用。

say.text: 诊断模型返回零行的原因。

howto.what_en: When dbt fails, Claude automatically diagnoses and fixes common issues: duplicate YML patches, ref not found, current_date problems, DuckDB errors, and zero-row models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when dbt run or dbt parse fails.

say_en.text: Fix duplicate YML patches in dbt.
say_en.note: Claude finds and removes duplicate entries across YML files.
Claude checks if it's a raw table and creates an ephemeral stub or replaces ref.

say_en.text: Diagnose why a model returns zero rows.
say_en.note: Claude uses binary search to find the condition causing zero rows.
